title: site
description: One waste site (reports merged within about 40 m, same type) as a GeoJSON Feature with Point geometry, coordinates [lon, lat] in WGS84. GET /sites/{id} returns one; GET /sites?bbox returns a FeatureCollection of them.

site_id.description: Kept in properties so MapLibre can promoteId it.

report_type.description: no_bin is a resident's report of no bin; a letter needs at least NO_BIN_MIN_REPORTERS distinct reporters and insights.no_bin_within_3km true (decision 20261010-1430).

status.description: open -> cleaned once at least 3 different people say it is cleared (contracts v1.12, decision 20261010-1855: accepted after-photos and cleaned votes, each person once by their latest word, cast after last_reported_at, at least 3 more than people whose latest vote is confirm cast after the first of them; see clearance and cleaned_by) -> reopened when a new photo merges in. removed (decision 20261010-1700): every report on an unverified site was withdrawn by its reporter; final, kept for the audit trail. expired (contracts v1.12, decision 20261010-1855): an open or reopened site with no report, vote or cleanup photo for 90 days after expires_at was last refreshed; final, kept for the audit trail, and a new report there founds a fresh site. GET /sites?bbox leaves out cleaned, removed and expired sites.

expires_at.description: Contracts v1.12, decision 20261010-1855: 90 days (SITE_TTL_DAYS) after the site's last activity (a merged report, any vote, an accepted cleanup photo). After it an open or reopened site counts as expired, on read and when the scores CronJob marks it. Not in required so older rows stay valid; a row without it expires 90 days after last_reported_at.

clearance.description: Contracts v1.12, decision 20261010-1855: progress towards cleaned. count is the distinct people (user id, else device token) whose latest word since last_reported_at says cleared: an accepted after-photo or a cleaned vote. still_there is the people whose latest vote is confirm cast after the first of them. needed is the larger of 3 (CLEANED_QUORUM) and still_there plus 3. Absent before the first cleared word; not in required so older rows stay valid.

removed_reason.description: Decision 20261010-1700: why a removed site left the map; withdrawn means its only reporter withdrew. photos_reported (contracts v1.15, decision 20261011-0310-hem-photo-flags): enough people reported the photos of an unverified site that every report left on it is a hidden photo. Null otherwise. Not in required so older rows stay valid.

removed_at.description: When the site was removed; null otherwise. Not in required so older rows stay valid.

cleaned_by.description: Decision 20261010-1700: what set the last cleaned status. Since decision 20261010-1855: after_photo when an accepted after-photo is among the people who cleared it, else votes. Null before the first cleanup. Not in required so older rows stay valid.

verification.description: Decision 20261010-1530. unverified from the first photo the models pass; verified once backers.count reaches backers.needed (10 different people); rejected when distinct no voters exceed backers.count by 3 or more (hidden from GET /sites?bbox). Verified and rejected are final. Reports on the site follow this value.

verified_count.description: Reports that count as verified: every report of a verified site, 0 otherwise.

corroborations.description: Confirm votes plus Me too reports from other devices.

zone_radius_m.description: Decision 20261010-1630: a no_bin site is a no-bin zone: reports within 500 m of its centre (the mean of its report points) join it, and each says no dustbin within this radius. Present exactly on no_bin sites.

backers.description: Distinct people backing the site, each counted once by user id, else by device token: by a model-passed photo of the site or by a confirm vote (their latest vote).

count.description: People who backed it either way; one person with a photo and a vote counts once.

cleaned.description: People whose latest vote says the site is cleared (decision 20261010-1700). Not in required so older rows stay valid.

photo_urls.description: Blurred public copies, newest first. Never an original. A photo's id is its report id, the file name of its key media/reports/{report_id}.jpg. A photo hidden after many reports (photo_flags) is left out.

photo_flags.description: Contracts v1.15, decision 20261011-0310-hem-photo-flags: residents' reports of a photo (POST /sites/{id}/photos/{photo}/flags), one entry per photo that has any, counted per photo by distinct people (user id and device, each once). Never names who reported or quotes why. Not in required so older rows stay valid.

photo_id.description: The report id of the photo.

count.description: Distinct people who reported this photo, each by their latest report.

warned.description: count is at least PHOTO_FLAG_WARN (3): the app blurs the photo more and shows it only after a tap.

hidden.description: count reached PHOTO_FLAG_HIDE (8), or PHOTO_FLAG_HIDE_EARLY (5) with at least PHOTO_FLAG_SURPLUS (5) more than the site's backers other than the photo's reporter. The photo has left photo_urls; final. The blurred copy and the report row stay for the audit trail.

cleanup_status.description: Latest cleanup after-photo, for polling after POST /sites/{id}/cleanup. pending_confirmation (contracts v1.12, decision 20261010-1855): the photo passed and counts as its uploader's cleared word, but fewer than 3 people have said so; the site stays on the map. accepted: the site is cleaned. Resets to none when a new photo merges in.

cleanup_photo_url.description: Blurred copy of the last after-photo that passed, pending or accepted.

burning.description: A verified report of this site showed burning; true exactly when insights.hazards lists burning.

location.description: The full location_lookup minus lat, lon and provenance. The worker writes it when merging; the api reads it from the sites table, so letters and the site panel need no extra lookup. Ids link to GET /areas/{kind}/{id}/scores.

local_body.description: Urban local body; its head is a letter's To. Null outside known bodies.

ward.description: Null where no open ward map exists.

assembly_seat.description: Null outside Rajasthan, where no assembly boundaries are loaded yet.

representatives.description: Offices and seats only; no names, no party. No councillor row without a ward, no mla row without an assembly seat.

brands.description: Only labels that were readable with confidence 0.8 or more.

cleaned_at.description: Last confirmed cleanup; null if never cleaned.

pilot.description: True inside the Jodhpur pilot area.

community.description: What residents' moderated notes on this site say, read by the note_analysis task (Bedrock only). Never quotes a note and never names its author. Absent until the first note is accepted; not in required so older rows stay valid.

notes_count.description: Moderated notes shown: site notes plus report notes.

people.description: Distinct people behind those notes; one person's several notes count once.

summary_en.description: One or two neutral sentences, for example: Residents say the dump has been here about 3 months and is burnt most weeks.

provider.description: junksnap with model community-template when the model's answer failed the checks and the summary was written from the signals.

reporters.description: Distinct people who reported this site: by user id, else by device. Not in required so older rows stay valid; the worker always writes it.

insights.description: Merged insights (decision 20261010-0202) of the site's verified reports only, the same reports burning comes from. Recomputed whenever a report on the site becomes verified: by the worker on merge, or by the api when votes settle the site. Not in required so v1 producers stay valid; the worker always writes it.

reports.description: Verified reports whose verification_result.insights were merged.

composition.description: One entry per material, largest first. share_pct is the mean over the merged reports, a missing material counting as 0.

reports.description: Merged reports that estimated this material.

size_class.description: Most common size class over the merged reports, ties going to the larger; never tonnage. Null when none was estimated.

hazards.description: Hazards any merged (verified) report showed; burning here is listed exactly when the burning flag above is true.

near.description: Sensitive places within 100 m, nearest first, from the ward crawler's OpenStreetMap layers (map_layers in data/wards/<city>.json): school, hospital, water (water bodies) and drain (open drains). The worker computes it in the location step. Empty when none or when the city has no crawled layers.

ref.description: The layer feature's ref, for example osm:way/123.

nearest_bin.description: The nearest known bin or collection point (OpenStreetMap waste baskets, waste disposal, recycling and transfer stations from the crawler's disposal map layer, and reviewed ward-record disposal points), measured from the site when it was founded. Null when none is known for the site's town. Not in required so older rows stay valid; the worker always writes it.

ref.description: The bin's id at the source, for example osm:node/123.

no_bin_within_3km.description: True when no known bin or collection point lies within BIN_RADIUS_M (3000 m by default) of the site; null when the site's town has no crawled bin data, so nothing can be said. Not in required so older rows stay valid; the worker always writes it.

community_signals.description: What residents' notes say, as structured and neutral signals. Each is true only when at least one moderated note says so.

duration_days.description: How long residents say the problem has existed, in days (about 90 for about 3 months); null when no note says.

recurring.description: Cleared before and comes back; null when no note says either way.

blocked_drain.description: A blocked drain or standing water.

animals.description: Stray animals, rats, flies or mosquitoes.

near_hospital.description: A nearby hospital or clinic is mentioned.

access_issue.description: The waste blocks a road, lane, footpath or entrance.

status.description: outdated where the loaded boundary predates a re-delimitation (Assam, Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh); letters never Cc the MP of an outdated seat. Null when unknown.

layer_source.description: The provenance of the map layer the place came from, as the ward crawler writes it.
